body.statement: Let \(P\in\mathcal P_W\) and let \(\widetilde q\) satisfy \(\sup_{\theta\in K}|\widetilde q(\theta)-q_P(\theta)|\leq r\). The relaxed sublevel set \(\{\theta\in K:\widetilde q(\theta)\leq r\}\) has outer directed-Hausdorff loss at most \(C\sqrt r\) when \(0\leq\delta(P)\leq C_{\delta}r\), and at most \(Cr/\sqrt{\delta_0}\) when \(\delta(P)\geq\delta_0\), where \(C\) depends only on the fixed class constants.
body.justification: This deterministic modulus is the mechanism by which one root-\(n\) score procedure adapts without regime selection.
body.gap: Generic criterion-set rate results do not isolate the exact square-root versus linear modulus of Watson et al.'s quadratic leakage score.
body.consumer: Any valid uniform score band immediately inherits contact and interior set-loss rates.
